questions.question: What did Jeremiah do in chapter 32 as a sign of future restoration?
options: Bought a field at Anathoth while Jerusalem was under siege
Led all of the people in a solemn fast and in earnest prayer
Tore down each of the idols set up in the temple courts
Built an altar of unhewn stones just outside the city walls
questions.answer: Bought a field at Anathoth while Jerusalem was under siege

questions.question: What did this purchase signify?
options: That the king would one day richly reward him for his faithfulness
That the great enemy would never once enter into the city at all
That houses, fields, and vineyards would again be bought in the land
That the long siege would surely be lifted within the space of a year
questions.answer: That houses, fields, and vineyards would again be bought in the land

questions.question: Jeremiah prayed, 'Ah, Lord GOD! ... Nothing is too hard for you.'
Houses and fields and vineyards shall again be _____ in this land.
Ah, Lord GOD! ... Nothing is too _____ for You.
